1.t: Read! In the Name of your Lord Who has created (all that exists).

2.t: He has created man from a clot (a piece of thick coagulated blood).

3.t: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous.

4.t: Who has taught (the writing) by the pen.

5.t: He has taught man that which he knew not.

6.t: Nay! Verily, man does transgress (in disbelief and evil deed).

8.t: Surely, unto your Lord is the return.

9.t: Have you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) seen him (i.e. Abû Jahl) who prevents

10.t: A slave (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) when he prays?

11.t: Tell me if he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is on the guidance (of Allâh)

13.t: Tell me if he (Abû Jahl) denies (the truth, i.e. this Qur’ân) and turns away?

14.t: Knows he not that Allâh does see (what he does)?

15.t: Nay! If he (Abû Jahl) ceases not, We will catch him by the forelock -

17.t: Then let him call upon his council (of helpers).

18.t: We will call out the guards of Hell (to deal with him)!

19.t: Nay! (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)! Do not obey him (Abû Jahl). Fall prostrate and draw near to Allâh!
